surfaces.name: mitosis command
surfaces.driver: python3 mitosis.py run from a scratch git repository with a local bare remote and stub dispatch, acceptance and pull-request commands (the way tests/test_mitosis.py drives it); read stdout's last JSON line, the exit code, the run directory's state.json and the branches, commits and pull request bodies it leaves

surfaces.name: mitosis skill
surfaces.driver: claude -p with --plugin-dir set to the build's worktree and --output-format stream-json, started from a scratch folder, sending a plain request to split and build work in a scratch repository with --plan-only; read which skill handled it from the transcript

surfaces.name: release check
surfaces.driver: python3 scripts/release_check.py --base <commit> from the worktree root, reading its exit code and output

python.value: python3 3.9 or later; CI runs 3.9 and 3.14

claude_cli.value: claude 2.1.308 (Claude Code) is on PATH and signed in; claude -p answered ok on 2026-10-26

deny_terms.value: CI's denied-terms scan reads the DENY_TERMS repository secret, which is not available locally

off_limits: pushing to the GitHub remote or opening, editing or merging real pull requests
running real model Workers through a dispatch command that calls a model, beyond a --plan-only skill run
writing under ~/.claude, ~/.mitosis or ~/.lighthouse, which live sessions and pipeline runs read
